answer_2.quote: We use an image classifier, FairFace, to classify the generated images by perceived gender... Text-to-image alignment is measured by embedding both the prompt text t and the generated image I with CLIP... To measure equity, we follow previous works in using the MAD score.

answer_4.quote: For FairFace, we also conduct a user study, to verify the agreement with human ratings, as shown in the Appendix.
answer_4.guideline: Verify agreement between model gender predictions and human judgments of perceived gender.
